parsed.name: HP 59501B HP-IB隔离式电源编程器
parsed.name_en: HP 59501B HP-IB Isolated Power Supply Programmer
parsed.description: HP 59501B 是一款通过 HP-IB（GPIB）控制的隔离式 D/A 电源编程器，可将数字指令转换为可编程模拟电压（常见量程 1V/10V，支持单极/双极模式），用于远程设定兼容电源或提供低电平直流编程信号。
parsed.description_en: The HP 59501B is an HP-IB (GPIB) controlled isolated D/A power-supply programmer. It converts digital commands into programmable analog voltage output (commonly 1 V/10 V ranges with unipolar/bipolar modes) for remote programming of compatible supplies or as a low-level DC programmable source.

actions.description: 根据给定的电压量程和设定值设置直流输出。
actions.description_en: Set the DC output using the specified voltage range and setpoint.
